items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well maybe Tim and I will have to go to Duluth.

ctx.x: longer than that although they lived in New York up until probably about five years ago. She had worked for the U prior to that and then they got married and they moved here and then the University up in Duluth, that particular branch, offered her a good job because she’s really good at what she does. And she took it.
Well maybe Tim and I will have to go to Duluth.
Max is wonderful. He comes to New York every once in a while.
